English · 中文
## What It Is
Tool Ultra is an All-in-One tool-plugin product for DeepSeek Harness, and an important component of
Swiftnest. Its goal is one coherent tool product across everyday tasks, web/MCP services, media and
device capabilities. The small core and replaceable extension packages are its internal architecture
; the product is more than a tool-directory browser.
Tools are browsable as a directory (category → group → tool), searchable by intent and loaded on dem
and, keeping unneeded schemas out of the model's context. Savings depend on catalog size, discovery/
load steps and provider caching: compare per-request schemas, total task tokens and task success sep
arately. Broad capability does not mean every external service or upload is enabled by default.
The current preview is distributed as source and modular packages; Swiftnest builds a pinned source
commit. An AI can install and configure the required modules. The published-package quick-start synt
ax below applies when those package versions are available on npm; it is not a claim that the rename
d 0.5.0 packages have already been published.

> **Renamed.** This project was `dsh-tool-manager`. Version 0.5.0 renames every
> package from `@lvy

-jsd/dsh-tool-manager-<name>` to `@lvy-jsd/dsh-tool-ultra-<name>`
> (the core is `@lvy-jsd/dsh-tool-

ultra-core`). Nothing else changes: the entry
> tools, the `toolCatalog` service (now also provided

as `toolUltra`), the hooks,
> the config and the state directory `<DSH_HOME>/tool-manager/` stay the

same.
> An existing profile can keep `@lvy-jsd/dsh-tool-manager`: from 0.5.0 it only
> re-exports t
he new core. Older extension releases keep working with the new core.

## Packages
| Package | What it does |
| `@lvy-jsd/dsh-tool-ultra-core` | Core: directory, `tools_ls` / `tools_load` / `tools_unload`, per-
agent allowlist, the `toolCatalog` extension service, plus intent retrieval + routing (`tools_find`
/ `tools_route` / `skills_find` / `skills_route`, BM25 with a Rust sidecar). Without extensions ever

y group is `uncategorized`. |
| `@lvy-jsd/dsh-tool-ultra-classifier-rules` | Places groups into cate

gories from built-in rules and your config overrides. |
| `@lvy-jsd/dsh-tool-ultra-risk-gate` | Conf

irms loading high-risk tools through the DSH approval channel, with a per-session allowlist. |
| `@l
vy-jsd/dsh-tool-ultra-persist` | Keeps loaded tools across a DSH restart, one state file per session

. |
| `@lvy-jsd/dsh-tool-ultra-panel` | Web panel: browse the tree, see each live session's loaded t
ools and token cost, load/unload from the UI, edit the always-on and high-risk lists, edit one tool'

s metadata, exempt one session. |
| `@lvy-jsd/dsh-tool-ultra-classifier-llm` | Places groups with a

small model, one request per group, cached by a hash of the group and its tool descriptions. |
| `@l
vy-jsd/dsh-tool-ultra-capability-bridge` | Load a named bundle of tools in one call: `tools_load(["c

ap:android-debug"])`. |
| `@lvy-jsd/dsh-tool-ultra-attribution-scan` | Group tools by the plugin pac

kage whose source defines them. |
| `@lvy-jsd/dsh-tool-ultra-pack-essentials` | Native tool pack, no
API keys: time zones and date math, a calculator with units (mathjs), weather (Open-Meteo), place s

earch (Nominatim), Wikipedia. |
| `@lvy-jsd/dsh-tool-ultra-pack-web` | Native tool pack: `web_read`
turns a page into clean Markdown (Readability + turndown), `web_links` lists its links. Refuses priv

ate addresses by default. |
| `@lvy-jsd/dsh-tool-ultra-pack-mcp` | MCP presets through DSH's MCP cli
ent: memory, sequential thinking, Context7, Playwright and filesystem start without keys; GitHub, Se
arXNG, Brave, Tavily, Firecrawl, Notion and AMap start once their key is set. `mcp_presets` shows th

e status. |

## Extending

Every feature beyond the core is an ordinary plugin using the `toolCatalog`
service, and the bundled

`classifier-rules` package is written exactly as a
third party would write it. Four extension point

classifier-rules` package is written exactly as a
third party would write it. Four extension points:
| Point | For |
| `registerClassifier({ name, priority, group?, categorize? })` | placing tools into groups and grou

ps into categories |
| `annotate(match, { group?, category?, risk?, summary? })` | runtime metadata;

`package.json` `dsh.toolCatalog` does the same without code |
| `registerVisibilityFilter({ name, f

ilter(agent, names) })` | narrowing what one agent may see — can only remove names |
| `registerTarg

etResolver({ name, prefix, resolve })` | owning a target prefix, e.g. `cap:<name>` |
| `registerRisk
Gate` / `registerStateProvider` | confirming high-risk loads / keeping state across a restart |

Hooks are plain events: `tool-catalog/before-load` (throw to veto),
`after-load`, `before-unload`, `

after-unload`, `before-rebuild`, `after-rebuild`,
`state-changed`.
